insights.title: High Frequency of Budget Management Calls
insights.description: The endpoint POST /sfdemosite130/nml510_refresh_control.xml was called 96 times in a single test, indicating potential inefficiencies.
insights.recommendation: Investigate the necessity of this repeated call and consider optimizing the workflow.

insights.title: UI Actions Trigger API Calls
insights.description: User actions such as logging in and generating reports consistently trigger specific API calls, indicating a clear relationship.
insights.recommendation: Document these relationships for better understanding of user interactions with the API.

executiveSummary:

• The most frequent API call was for budget management, occurring 96 times in one test.
• User authentication processes were consistently triggered across all workflows.
• Report generation workflows showed clear patterns of API interactions.
• Potential inefficiencies in repeated API calls warrant further investigation.
• Understanding UI and API relationships can enhance user experience and system performance.
